pages.text: Over a chasm whose floor is lost in fog lies a heap of bones. When you come in, it rises - and hunts you over the bridges between the pillars. If it catches you, that is the end: only a totem gives a second life.$(br2)It trips on the run - over holes, at sharp turns, and when an arrow takes it in the legs. Strike while it is down.
Out of the fog under the bridges the dead climb the pillars. The fires on the pillars burn until he walks over them.$(br2)His spoils wait afterwards in a chained chest in the middle of the hall.
